title: Meta’s AI agent has been blocked from using Amazon.com
summary: Amazon has its own cohort of foundation models, along with one of the most popular inference platforms on the internet. As long as they're under no legal obligation to open the doors to Muse, why would they?
title_es: Amazon bloquea al agente Muse de Meta
bajada: Amazon impidió que Muse acceda a Amazon.com, argumentando que viola sus términos de servicio. El bloqueo refleja tensiones crecientes entre gigantes tecnológicos sobre el acceso de agentes IA a plataformas comerciales.
bajada_en: Amazon blocked Muse from accessing Amazon.com, citing violations of its terms of service. The move reflects growing tensions between tech giants over AI agent access to commercial platforms.

title: Muse, Meta's extraordinarily privileged AI assistant, has a serious 0-day
summary: A simple ClickFix attack is only one way to completely hijack the new agent.
title_es: Muse de Meta tiene una vulnerabilidad crítica sin parche
bajada: El agente Muse de Meta contiene un fallo de seguridad 0-day que permite hijacking mediante ataque ClickFix. La vulnerabilidad expone riesgos de seguridad en agentes con permisos elevados.
bajada_en: Meta's Muse agent contains a 0-day security flaw allowing hijacking via ClickFix attack. The vulnerability exposes security risks in highly privileged AI agents.

title: Meta’s Muse Tries (and Fails) to Disrupt Amazon
summary: Everyone loves a brawl between two big tech firms—even other tech CEOs. Amazon’s block on Meta Platforms’ new Muse personal agentaccessing its shopping site,which came tolight Sunday night,prompted Palo Alto Networks CEO Nikesh Arora topost on X on Mondaythat the episode signals “a bigger battle than anyone anticipates.”He may be right: while Amazon has previouslyblocked Google and OpenAI shopping botswithout drama, Amazon’s action against Meta is a bit more reminiscent of its blocking of Perplexity’s agent, whichsparked a lawsuit that is still underway.And this is just the beginning. Arora, for instance, predicted that eventually everyone from Apple to Google and the AI firms will offer similar personal agents. (See ourreport todayon what OpenAI is up to.)
title_es: Conflicto entre Meta y Amazon por acceso a shopping
bajada: Amazon bloqueó Muse de Meta en su plataforma, escalando tensiones competitivas entre gigantes tech sobre acceso de agentes IA. El incidente refleja dinámicas similares a conflictos previos con Perplexity y señala batallas futuras por dominación de agentes personales.
bajada_en: Amazon's block of Meta's Muse escalates competitive tensions between tech giants over AI agent access. The incident mirrors previous conflicts with Perplexity and signals future battles for personal agent dominance.

title: Amazon blocks Meta’s Muse AI agent
summary: Meta's Muse AI agent has been blocked from shopping Amazon on behalf of its users, GeekWire reports. A popup message started appearing on Sunday for Muse users saying that "continued access by an unauthorized AI agent violates Amazon's Conditions of Use, to which our customers have agreed." According to GeekWire, Meta didn't notify Amazon that […]
title_es: Amazon bloquea a Muse: escalada de conflicto comercial
bajada: Amazon bloqueó el acceso de Muse a su plataforma, argumentando violación de términos de servicio. El evento marca un punto de quiebre en dinámicas de competencia entre agentes de IA y plataformas comerciales establecidas.
bajada_en: Amazon blocked Muse's access to its platform, citing terms of service violations. The event marks a turning point in competition dynamics between AI agents and established commercial platforms.

title: Building standards for the next phase of AI
summary: OpenAI outlines a path to shared global AI standards, calling for coordinated evaluation, reporting, and governance to improve safety.
title_es: OpenAI propone estándares globales para IA responsable
bajada: OpenAI presentó un plan para crear estándares globales compartidos en IA, incluyendo evaluación coordinada, reportes y gobernanza mejorada. La propuesta busca establecer marcos comunes para mejorar la seguridad en el desarrollo de IA.
bajada_en: OpenAI unveiled a plan for shared global AI standards, including coordinated evaluation, reporting, and improved governance. The proposal aims to establish common frameworks to enhance safety in AI development.

title: Meta’s Muse is outpacing ChatGPT’s early mobile launch
summary: Meta’s new AI agent Muse has racked up more downloads and daily active users in the U.S. and Canada than ChatGPT did over the same period after its mobile debut, according to new estimates from Appfigures.
title_es: Meta's Muse supera descargas iniciales de ChatGPT móvil
bajada: El agente de IA Muse de Meta alcanzó más descargas y usuarios activos diarios que ChatGPT en su lanzamiento móvil durante el mismo período. El dato sugiere una adopción acelerada de agentes de IA en competencia directa con OpenAI.
bajada_en: Meta's Muse AI agent achieved more downloads and daily active users than ChatGPT had during its mobile launch. The metric suggests accelerated adoption of AI agents competing directly with OpenAI.

title: California tightens rules on AI data center energy and water use
summary: California Gov. Gavin Newsom has signed seven bills designed to prevent AI data centers from passing utility costs onto residents, as reported earlier by the Los Angeles Times. The package of laws requires the California Public Utilities Commission to introduce a new rate classification for data centers, while forcing them to pay for upgrades to […]
title_es: California regulará consumo energético de centros de datos IA
bajada: California aprobó siete leyes para evitar que centros de datos de IA trasladen costos de servicios a residentes. Las normativas requieren nuevas clasificaciones de tarifas e inversión de infraestructura por parte de operadores.
bajada_en: California approved seven laws to prevent AI data centers from passing utility costs to residents. The regulations require new rate classifications and infrastructure investment from operators.

title: US and China Discuss Alerting Each Other to AI National Security Threats
summary: Officials discussed setting up a mechanism for the two countries to notify each other of AI incidents which could threaten national security.
title_es: EE.UU. y China discuten alertas sobre amenazas IA
bajada: Funcionarios de EE.UU. y China discutieron crear un mecanismo para notificarse mutuamente sobre incidentes de IA que amenacen seguridad nacional. La iniciativa busca cooperación en gestión de riesgos de IA a nivel global.
bajada_en: US and China officials discussed creating a mechanism to alert each other about AI incidents threatening national security. The initiative seeks global cooperation on AI risk management.

title: Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence
summary: OpenAI is working with an independent Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence to guide the review and communication of emerging AI results.
title_es: OpenAI crea grupo asesor sobre matemáticas e IA
bajada: OpenAI estableció un grupo asesor independiente para guiar la revisión y comunicación de resultados emergentes en IA. La iniciativa busca mejorar la transparencia y rigor en el desarrollo de nuevos avances.
bajada_en: OpenAI established an independent advisory group to guide the review and communication of emerging AI results. The initiative aims to improve transparency and rigor in the development of new breakthroughs.

title: Higgsfield AI ships new video features in a day with GPT-6 Astra
summary: With GPT-6 Astra, Higgsfield AI makes video ad creation easier for small businesses and brings new creative tools to market faster.
title_es: Higgsfield AI lanza features de video con GPT-6 Astra
bajada: Higgsfield AI utilizó GPT-6 Astra para desarrollar nuevas herramientas de creación de videos publicitarios en un día. El logro demuestra la velocidad de desarrollo que permite la última generación de modelos de OpenAI.
bajada_en: Higgsfield AI used GPT-6 Astra to develop new video ad creation tools in a single day. The achievement demonstrates the development speed enabled by OpenAI's latest generation models.

title: NVIDIA Launches DSX Ready to Qualify Power and Cooling Products for AI Factories
summary: Every AI factory needs power and cooling that fit its computing architecture. As AI infrastructure expands, power, cooling, water, site and grid constraints are shaping what builders can deploy. Choosing products that fit the complete factory design helps builders turn computing capacity into useful AI output. To help builders make those decisions, NVIDIA is introducing […]
title_es: NVIDIA lanza DSX para calificar productos de potencia en IA
bajada: NVIDIA introdujo DSX Ready, una iniciativa para ayudar a constructores de centros de IA a elegir productos de potencia y enfriamiento que se adapten a su arquitectura. La solución aborda limitaciones crecientes de infraestructura en la expansión de fábricas de IA.
bajada_en: NVIDIA introduced DSX Ready to help AI data center builders select power and cooling products that fit their architecture. The solution addresses growing infrastructure constraints in AI factory expansion.

title: Pruning LLMs Like a Physicist: Block Removal as an Ising Optimization Problem
title_es: Pruning de LLMs usando optimización de Ising
bajada: Hugging Face publicó una técnica para podar modelos de lenguaje tratándolos como problemas de optimización física mediante el modelo de Ising. El método ofrece un enfoque novedoso para reducir tamaño de modelos manteniendo rendimiento.
bajada_en: Hugging Face published a technique for pruning language models using Ising optimization, treating them as physics problems. The method offers a novel approach to reduce model size while maintaining performance.

title: tokenizers v1: encode, decode and scaling, measured
title_es: Tokenizers v1: mejoras en rendimiento y escalabilidad
bajada: Hugging Face lanzó tokenizers v1 con optimizaciones en encode, decode y mediciones de escalabilidad. La actualización busca mejorar eficiencia en procesamiento de tokens para developers.
bajada_en: Hugging Face released tokenizers v1 with improvements to encode, decode and scaling measurements. The update aims to enhance token processing efficiency for developers.

title: AI Security Is an Engineering Problem — How to Solve It at Every Layer of the Agent Stack
summary: AI security is an engineering problem. That means defined security requirements, enforceable controls, named owners and evidence that protections work.  As AI becomes more capable, the industry must accelerate security engineering, broaden access to defensive tools and share what works faster.  Technology Changes, Security Fundamentals Endure The internet and cloud computing changed how software operates, […]
title_es: NVIDIA: seguridad de IA como problema de ingeniería
bajada: NVIDIA presentó un enfoque de ingeniería para seguridad en agentes de IA, enfatizando requisitos definidos, controles y validación. El framework busca acelerar prácticas defensivas compartiendo soluciones efectivas entre la industria.
bajada_en: NVIDIA presented an engineering approach to AI agent security emphasizing defined requirements and enforceable controls. The framework aims to accelerate defensive practices through industry knowledge sharing.

title: World Models Need More Intelligence, Says Luma CEO Amit Jain
summary: The AI boom has been built largely on progress in language models, but a different approach has gained enormous attention in the industry this year: world models, which are designed to generate accurate predictions about the physical world, rather than words and numbers.I sat down with Amit Jain, co-founder and CEO of Luma AI, to discuss the promise of world models—and where current approaches to training them still fall short—on thelatest episode of AI Deep Dive, The Information’s new show exploring the hard problems on tech’s frontier.
title_es: CEO de Luma: world models necesitan más inteligencia
bajada: Amit Jain, CEO de Luma AI, discute limitaciones actuales de world models para predicción del mundo físico. El debate refleja el creciente enfoque en alternatives a language models para tareas que requieren razonamiento sobre el mundo real.
bajada_en: Luma AI CEO Amit Jain discusses current limitations of world models for physical world prediction. The discussion reflects growing focus on language model alternatives for real-world reasoning tasks.
